tests.exercises: advec: time-dependent linear advection of a cosine bell on the sphere (Williamson test case 2), 96 h at a 600 s step on 23x45 points
tests.why: deterministic spectral model advanced for a fixed number of steps; the printed max and RMS errors are discretization-level values (1e-2 for advection, 1e-7 for shallow water) reproducible across builds, and the check dumps the final fields for a pointwise comparison; the step count and window are knobs

tests.exercises: helmsph: Helmholtz equation on the sphere on a 10 degree grid
tests.why: prints one max error that is a round-off residual (2.5e-15); graded as an invariant bound on the residual and pointwise on the dumped solution field
